note: Captured live against E19 (RFC) 2026-09-21 while chasing GitHub #211: a fresh data element's own readMetadata answers with NO adtcore:description on the root <blue:wbobj> element at all — SAP does not echo it back there — while the sibling adtcore:packageRef DOES carry one (the package's own description). This is the document shape that made the unscoped patchXmlAttribute('adtcore:description', ...) corrupt packageRef's description instead of setting the data element's own, and is what create-dataelement--01-ddic-dataelements (a CREATE response, which does echo description on root) does not exercise.
